extra.message: Command injection: user input from request.GET.get('host') is concatenated directly into an os.system() shell call ('ping -c 1 ' + host) with no sanitization. cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: Insecure deserialization: pickle.loads() is called on attacker-controlled data (request.body, or request.GET['blob'] optionally base64-decoded). Pickle deserialization of untrusted input allows arbitrary code execution; a crafted pickle payload can run any Python code on the server.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) / code injection: user input from request.GET.get('fragment') is concatenated into a Jinja2 Template string and rendered with .render(). An attacker can inject template expressions such as {{ config }} or {{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }} to read server secrets or achieve remote code execution. The output is returned as text/html.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: Path traversal (arbitrary file write): the user-controlled 'name' parameter from request.GET is joined directly into a filesystem path (BASE_EXPORT_DIR / name) and request.body is written to that path with write_bytes(). An attacker can supply '../' sequences (e.g., name=../../etc/cron.d/evil) to write arbitrary files anywhere on the filesystem, leading to remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: Path traversal (arbitrary file write): the user-controlled 'ref' parameter from request.GET is interpolated into a file path (BASE_EXPORT_DIR / f"{ref}.json") which is then written via write_text(). cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: Open redirect: the user-controlled 'lane' parameter from request.GET is passed directly to django.shortcuts.redirect() with no validation that it is a safe internal path. extra.message: Missing authentication: acct_identity_ping_343 is the only ops endpoint that does NOT call _wrk_gate() (the internal token check) and is not protected by login_required. cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for a Critical Function

extra.message: CORS misconfiguration: the request Origin header value is reflected verbatim into Access-Control-Allow-Origin while Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is set to 'true'.
